description: The company's price list for the machines its computations run on — what list_computations and computation_hours work costs out from. Per machine, every price it has had, newest first ('current' is the row in force today): 'kind' monthly (a machine of our own, its month shared out by load: a core-hour at monthlyPrice ÷ (cores × hours in the month); 'computeCores' is the part of it given to computations, the rest of the machine doing other work) or tariff (a service billed by the second: coreSecond, memoryGiBSecond, gpuRates by type); the currency (converted to dollars at the ECB rate of each job's day); 'validFrom'; 'source', 'checkedOn' and 'basis' — list, invoice or estimate; 'typeAssumed' where the provider's plan was matched by cores and memory rather than confirmed; 'note' (an estimate's formula). 'builtIn' is Modal's public tariff, used for machine 'modal' while the company has no row of its own. 'unpriced' lists machines jobs reported that no row prices — their jobs have no cost, never a zero. 'mayChange' says whether you may change the list (set_machine_price).
name: list_machine_prices
title: List machine prices
